Sound samples created by Andrea Biasior <reusenoise@gmail.com> from a Yamaha RBX bass guitar. It was sent for inclusion in FreePats on September 2019, under the terms of the Creative Commons CC0 1.0 public domain dedication.
Samples by Andrea Biasior; distributed by FreePats.

Imitation of the Yamaha DX7 electric piano, a FM sythesis instrument that was popular in the 1980s. These sound samples simulate the "E. Piano 1" patch of the DX7, used in many 1980s popular songs. Recorded from Hexter software synthesizer. Hexter is a free software program that accurately models the sound generation algorithm of the original instrument. For best quality and flexibility we recommend to run Hexter synthesizer directly in your computer. These sound banks are provided for convenience when sample-based synthesizers are preferred and for building complete sound sets.

Imitation of the Yamaha DX7 electric piano, a FM sythesis instrument that was popular in the 1980s. These sound samples simulate a bright variation of an electric piano patch. Recorded from Hexter software synthesizer. Hexter is a free software program that accurately models the sound generation algorithm of the original instrument. For best quality and flexibility we recommend to run Hexter synthesizer directly in your computer. These sound banks are provided for convenience when sample-based synthesizers are preferred and for building complete sound sets.

This sound bank is made with samples of a jaw harp , sent by Eugene Vlaskin to the FreePats project on February 2018: I recorded this sample pack in autumn of 2017 in the North West of Sakhalin (in Nekrasovka) with the aid of Michail Chayka (a Nivkh musician who played jaw harp) and his mother N.K. Chayka. We used school sound equipment for this recording, so the quality is not very good but after processing in Audacity it seems to me good enough.
Recorded and assembled by Roberto for FreePats.

Recorded by Mateusz Dąbrowski from a Flight Fireball ukulele (tenor), RØDE Podcaster mic, one recording session, fixed mic position and gain throughout. Offered to FreePats on August 2026. The ukulele is sampled across two octaves (C4-C6). It includes two percussive articulations: a body tap and a chuck (strum into damped strings), mapped outside the instrument's range to B2 and C3.

Imitation of an electromechanical organ, known as a Hammond organ due to its inventor and original manufacturer. Samples and sound bank made by Roberto <roberto@zenvoid.org> for the FreePats project. Recorded from setBfree software synthesizer. setBfree is a free software program that accurately imitates the sound of electromechanical organs. For best quality and flexibility we recommend to run setBfree synthesizer directly in your computer. These sound banks are provided for convenience when sample-based synthesizers are preferred and for building complete sound sets.

Imitation of an electromechanical organ, known as a Hammond organ due to its inventor and original manufacturer. This is a percussive sound variation. Samples and sound bank by Strix SoundFont Team <dsoundfont123@gmail.com>, sent to the FreePats project on June/July 2019. Recorded from setBfree software synthesizer. setBfree is a free software program that accurately imitates the sound of electromechanical organs.

Imitation of an electromechanical organ, known as a Hammond organ due to its inventor and original manufacturer. This is a classic rock sound variation. Samples and sound bank by Strix SoundFont Team <dsoundfont123@gmail.com>, sent to the FreePats project on June/July 2019. Recorded from setBfree software synthesizer. setBfree is a free software program that accurately imitates the sound of electromechanical organs.

Sound bank made by roberto@zenvoid.org for the FreePats project. Recorded from Aeolus pipe organ emulator on Debian GNU/Linux operating system. Aeolus is a free software synthesizer made by Fons Adriaensen. For best quality and flexibility we recommend to run Aeolus synthesizer directly in your computer. These sound banks are provided for convenience when sample-based synthesizers are preferred and for building complete sound sets.
Recorded by Lars Muldjord in 2010; simplified stereo SF2 assembled by Roberto for FreePats from MuldjordKit.

Created by Roberto <roberto@zenvoid.org> with Yoshimi and Geonkick free software synthesizers, and edited with Audacity . They are an aproximation to drum kit sounds commonly used on vintage electronic music made with analog synthesizers.
Recorded by Gonzalo and Roberto; edited and assembled by Roberto for FreePats. Thanks to Inma Martínez de Miguel and Claudia Marín Martínez.

Built from the Zenph Studios Yamaha Disklavier Pro Piano Multisamples for OLPC . The soundfont and modifications to the original sound samples are produced by roberto@zenvoid.org for the FreePats project. Samples from the OLPC sound sample library have been donated to Dr. Richard Boulanger @ cSounds.com specifically to support the OLPC developers, students, XO users, and computer and electronic musicians everywhere. The Disklavier Pro has an internal electronically-controlled mechanism that allows it to play sounds with very precise specifications. The original sound samples were performed by computer and specifically recorded for OLPC by Dr. Mikhail Krishtal, Director of Music Research and Production, and his team at Zenph Studios. They are included in the OLPC sound sample library. Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 license.

Yamaha C5, recorded with two AKG c414 disposed in an AB position ~12cm above the strings, 48kHz 24bit, 16 velocity layers. Sampled in minor thirds from the lowest A. Hammer noise releases chromatically sampled in one layer. String resonance releases in minor thirds in three layers. Author: Alexander Holm, axeldenstore (at) gmail (dot) com. Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 license.

Recorded by Piotr Barcz from a Francis Bacon player piano. It's a wonderful historic piano with an authentic honky-tonk tone. The sounds were recorded in stereo with a Zoom H1n sound recorder, at the approximate position where the pianist's head would be, and they were sent to FreePats on February 2020. It's quite difficult to find pianos like this nowadays, many thanks to Piotr for sharing these samples with us.

Clarinet samples by Tyler Dence <tyzoid.d@gmail.com> (Recording Engineer) and Kaili Dence (Performer), contributed to the FreePats project on August 2017. Recorded with an AudioTechnica AT873R microphone, placed a foot and a half away from the bell of the instrument, angled towards the middle section.

Made with samples of the Versilian Community Sample Library, a CC0 sample library created by Versilian Studios LLC . This sound bank is assembled by roberto@zenvoid.org. Samples have been edited and they have infinite sustain loops.

Simulation of the famous TX81Z patch, Lately Bass. Made by Yingchun Soul (迎春心情) with Dexed and sent to FreePats on June 2023. This version has been adapted for FreePats to support SFZ and SF2 formats.

General MIDI instrument #39: Synth Bass 1. Recorded from ZynAddSubFX / Yoshimi software synthesizers. ZynAddSubFX and Yoshimi are free software programs capable of creating many different sounds with several synthesis engines, filters and effects.

General MIDI instrument #40: Synth Bass 2. These sound samples simulate the "BASS 1" patch of the Yamaha DX7, a FM sythesis instrument that was used in many 1980s popular songs. Recorded from Hexter software synthesizer. Hexter is a free software program that accurately models the sound generation algorithm of the original instrument. For best quality and flexibility we recommend to run Hexter synthesizer directly in your computer. These sound banks are provided for convenience when sample-based synthesizers are preferred and for building complete sound sets.

General MIDI instrument #63: Synth Brass 1. Recorded from ZynAddSubFX / Yoshimi software synthesizers. ZynAddSubFX and Yoshimi are free software programs capable of creating many different sounds with several synthesis engines, filters and effects.

General MIDI instrument #63: Synth Brass 2. Samples by Strix SoundFont Team <dsoundfont123@gmail.com>, sent to the FreePats project on June 2018. This sound set emulates the 'BRASS 7' patch in the Yamaha DX7. Recorded from Dexed , a software synthesizer that emulates the sound synthesis algorithm of the DX7.

General MIDI instrument #102: Synth FX 6 (goblins). Samples by 快乐爱的小精灵 (Elf of Happy and Love) <lovebodhi@yandex.com>, sent to the FreePats project on April 2020. Made with ZynAddSubFX software synthesizer. This version is edited by roberto@zenvoid.org. Originally it was Echoes FX, but it turned into the instrument #102 (goblins), which fits very well.

General MIDI instrument #98: Synth FX 2 (soundtrack). Samples by 快乐爱的小精灵 (Elf of Happy and Love) <lovebodhi@yandex.com>, sent to the FreePats project on March 2020. Made with ZynAddSubFX software synthesizer.
General MIDI instrument #104: Synth FX 8 (sci-fi). Samples by 快乐爱的小精灵 (Elf of Happy and Love) <lovebodhi@yandex.com>, sent to the FreePats project on April 2020. Made with Surge software synthesizer.
General MIDI instrument #99: Synth FX 3 (crystal). Samples by Strix SoundFont Team <dsoundfont123@gmail.com>, sent to the FreePats project on November 2018. Recorded from Dexed software synthesizer.

General MIDI instrument #88: Synth Lead 8 (bass + lead). Samples by 快乐爱的小精灵 (Elf of Happy and Love) <lovebodhi@yandex.com>, sent to the FreePats project on April 2020. Made with Surge software synthesizer.

General MIDI instrument #87: Synth Lead 7 (fifths). Samples by 快乐爱的小精灵 (Elf of Happy and Love) <lovebodhi@yandex.com>, sent to the FreePats project on April 2020. Made with Surge software synthesizer.
General MIDI instrument #81: Synth Lead 1 (square). Made with ZynAddSubFX / Yoshimi software synthesizers.
General MIDI instrument #83: Synth Lead 3 (calliope). Made with a combination of Hexter and ZynAddSubFX / Yoshimi software synthesizers.

General MIDI instrument #92: Synth Pad 4 (choir). Samples by 快乐爱的小精灵 (Elf of Happy and Love) <lovebodhi@yandex.com>, sent to the FreePats project on April 2020. Made with ZynAddSubFX software synthesizer.
General MIDI instrument #96: Synth Pad 8 (sweep). It has been created with ZynAddSubFX / Yoshimi software synthesizers.
General MIDI instrument #89: Synth Pad 1 (new age). It has been created with ZynAddSubFX / Yoshimi software synthesizers.

General MIDI instrument #93: Synth Pad 5 (bowed). Samples and sound bank by Strix SoundFont Team <dsoundfont123@gmail.com>. It has been created with ZynAddSubFX / Yoshimi software synthesizers and an instrument file adapted by roberto@zenvoid.org.
General MIDI instrument #51: Synth Strings 1. Made with ZynAddSubFX / Yoshimi software synthesizers.
General MIDI instrument #52: Synth Strings 2. Made with ZynAddSubFX / Yoshimi software synthesizers.

This sound bank has been created from real instrument recordings, thanks to Xavimart (Javier), a musician that maintains a collection of musical instruments from many places around the world. He granted us access to his collection and helped with the performance and recording for all day long. The ocarina was recorded on January 2019 by Xavimart, Gonzalo <humanogonzalo@gmail.com> and Roberto <roberto@zenvoid.org>, with two Zoom H1 portable recorders. Raw recordings were cropped, edited, and processed by Roberto, using free software programs.

Sound bank assembled for the FreePats project, using sound samples from the FS Seagull Steel String Acoustic Guitar by FlameStudios . Contains a small subset of samples from the original GIG file. Samples had been modified, filtered and trimmed. GNU General Public License version 3 or later, with a special exception . Thanks to Gary Campion from FlameStudios for giving permission to distribute his samples under the FreePats GPL special exception.

Concert Harp sound bank made with samples of the Versilian Community Sample Library, a CC0 sample library created by Versilian Studios LLC . Thanks to Sam Gossner, founder of Versilian Studios, for providing those samples under a free license and answering our emails. Performer: K. Smith. Location: Boston, MA. Small room. Microphones: 2x Rode NT1-A spaced pair, 2x AT Pro 37's close. Interface: Focusrite Scarlett 18i8 (first gen). Recorded on 2015-01-26. This sound bank is assembled by roberto@zenvoid.org. Samples have been edited, if you need the original unprocessed sounds, please visit the VCSL repository .
